top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is an invention with a clear originator (Katori's magic-wavelength lattice) and a clear route to the highest precision and many-body regimes (Ye). The 1e-18 performance is verified by independent comparisons between laboratories, and it has opened a door to tests of relativity and many-body physics. The two-name allocation is clean and the citation scope is defensible, so this is mature and verified enough to award now rather than withhold.
